summary: Critical figure crop misalignments: p1-fig1b, p2-sol-fig1, p3-sol-fig1, and p4-sol-fig2 are capturing problem/solution text instead of the intended diagrams, making them unusable for students.

defects.description: p1-fig1b crop at [660, 450, 950, 665] captures problem text from part б) statement instead of the actual figure (б) diagram. The figure should show the inclined rod with springs in opposite directions.

p2-sol-fig1 crop at [130, 505, 500, 720] captures mostly solution text (formulas) with minimal diagram content. Should show the complete pV-diagram for the Carnot cycle with isotherms and adiabats clearly visible.

p3-sol-fig1 crop at [560, 380, 960, 560] captures solution text and formulas instead of the ray path diagram through the double-convex lens. Diagram showing angles α, β, γ, δ, ε, ζ, η and focal distance f is not properly visible.
p4-sol-fig2 crop at [110, 165, 580, 320] captures solution text and equations instead of the momentum vector diagram for maximum scattering angle. Should show p (horizontal), p₁ and p₂ at 180° angle.
